seo.title: Pet Waste Clean-ups & Collections in Aberdare | Scoop Patrol
seo.description: Weekly, fortnightly and one-off pet waste garden clean-ups and collections across Aberdare and Rhondda Cynon Taf. From £10 per clean. NRW registered.

hero.headingPrefix: Pet Waste Garden Clean-ups and Collections in
hero.lead: Regular and flexible one-off garden clean-ups and collections for pet owners across Aberdare and Rhondda Cynon Taf.
hero.imageAlt: A dog and a cat sitting together on a clean, freshly cleared garden lawn in Aberdare
hero.badgeText: Your garden, fresh, safe, paws and feet ready.

pricing.heading: Tailored pricing for your garden's unique needs
pricing.lead: We consider pets, garden size, clean-up frequency and even big build-ups. Ensuring a fair quote every time.

spotTheDifference.heading: From Mess to Fresh: Results You Can Trust

reviews.heading: Trusted by dog owners across The Valleys

why.heading: For Families, Busy Schedules and those who need Support
why.lead: We started Scoop Patrol because we saw the community needed a helping hand. Especially for those struggling on their own. That's why we do what we do, to keep every space clean and every neighbour supported.
points: Only a message away to start today!
why.imageAlt: A family and their dog enjoying a clean, tidy back garden on a summer afternoon

whoWeWorkWith.heading: From family gardens to commercial sites
whoWeWorkWith.lead: Whether it's a family garden or a commercial site, we clean and collect all year round.

whatToExpect.heading: Simple and easy for you, whether cleaning or collecting
whatToExpect.lead: Just contact us, get a price, make an appointment and we're on patrol!

areas.heading: Aberdare and the surrounding areas
areas.lead: If you're local to any of these areas, we can likely fit your garden onto a regular route.

howToBook.heading: Getting started takes one message
howToBook.lead: Two ways in, depending on what you need.

cards.heading: Booking a garden clean
steps: Message us or fill in the quote form with your postcode, garden size and number of pets
Send a photo if you can, it helps us quote fairly, especially for first cleans
We confirm your price and a first visit date, usually the same day
Choose weekly, fortnightly or a one-off

cards.heading: Booking a collection
steps: Tell us roughly how much you need collected and how often
We confirm a price and a collection day
Leave your bagged waste out on the day, you don't need to be home
We collect, dispose of it legally, and you're done

quoteSection.heading: Tell us about your garden
quoteSection.lead: Fill this in and it opens WhatsApp with your details ready to send. We'll come back with a fair price the same day.

finalCta.heading: Ready for a fresh garden?
finalCta.body: Message us your postcode, garden size and number of pets, we'll come back with a fair price the same day.
